title: Missing Brave key test depends on ambient environment
reasoning: This test asserts that WebSearchTool reports missing Brave configuration, but it does not clear BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY and does not monkeypatch _resolve_api_key. If a developer or CI environment has BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY set, the test no longer exercises the missing-configuration branch and may perform the configured path instead, making the backend test suite environment-dependent.
reproduction: Run this test with BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY set in the environment; the asserted missing-configuration error is no longer guaranteed.
recommendation: Use monkeypatch.delenv("BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY", raising=False) in this test or monkeypatch _resolve_api_key to return None so the intended branch is deterministic.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The test is intended to cover the missing configuration path but omits the environment isolation needed to make that path stable.
suggestedRegressionTest: Keep this test but explicitly set the environment to the configured and unconfigured cases so both branches are deterministic.
minimumFixScope: Update tests/backend/test_web_search_tool.py to clear or mock Brave configuration in the missing-configuration test.
